title: For SEA Market: Add  Mandatory Attributes to Baby&Maternity and Automotive&Motorcycle Categories
breadcrumb: For SEA Market: Add  Mandatory Attributes to Baby&Maternity and Automotive&Motorcycle Categories
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2026-07-07
html:
What is changing?

Starting from 1 August 2026, partners will be required to provide two mandatory product attributes "Recommended Age" and "Baby Life Stage" to Baby & Maternity category, another two mandatory product attributes "Applicable Brand" and "Model" to Automotive & Motorcycle category.

Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to local to local and cross border sellers in SEA market.

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without these mandatory attributes sellers will not be able to create and update products. Use the Get Attributes to check what attributes are mandatory and pass attribute values via the Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product to help sellers fill in the attribute values.
